Firm linked to Jensen Huang's ex-lover reportedly brokered nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for China
Update:
In a statement to Reuters, Megaspeed said Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang officially left the company on August 30, 2025, and has no current role there. Huang became the controlling shareholder of Megaspeed in March 2023, according to Washington-based research group C4ADS. The company said it conducted "legitimate and lawful business" and had retained external legal counsel to conduct an internal investigation.
The New York Times reported in October 2025 that Megaspeed was under investigation over whether it helped Chinese customers obtain export-controlled Nvidia chips. There has also been speculation that Alice Huang may be a Chinese spy, which has not been confirmed.
Original article, November 15, 2026:
Megaspeed arranged nearly $12 billion worth of Nvidia high-performance chip orders for Chinese companies between March 2024 and June 2025, according to documents reviewed by the Wall Street Journal. The company is owned by Alice Huang, the former lover of since-ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Megaspeed shipped the chips to buyers in China who maintained long-standing business ties with local tech giants, the WSJ reports. The orders covered several hundred thousand chips that the US had sought to keep out of China through export controls. Megaspeed reportedly gained preferential access to scarce AI chips as an Nvidia cloud partner, apparently because it counted Chinese cloud and tech company Alibaba as a major client.
Nvidia officially reported $12.4 billion in China revenue over six months, accounting for 7 percent of total revenue. Short-selling firm Culper Research estimates, however, that more than 20 percent of Nvidia's revenue in the last fiscal year came from Chinese customers. A significant share of that China business may have flowed through indirect channels.

digest_he: מסמכים שפורסמו מעלים כי חברת מגאספיד, שהייתה בבעלותה של אליס הואנג – מקורבתו לשעבר של מנכ"ל Nvidia לשעבר ג'נסן הואנג – ערכה הזמנות של שבבי בינה מלאכותית מתקדמים עבור חברות סיניות בהיקף של כמעט 12 מיליארד דולר בין השנים 2024 ל-2025. המשלוחים הללו הגיעו לגורמים בסין למרות הפיקוח האמריקאי על הייצוא, כשלפי ההערכות נתח המכירות של Nvidia לסין עשוי להיות גבוה משמעותית מהנתונים הרשמיים שדווחו. מגאספיד מסרה בתגובה כי הואנג עצמה עזבה את החברה עוד בשנת 2025 וכי הפעילות העסקית שלה מתנהלת כחוק.
